title: Report v2 dashboard: the HTML dashboard's counters are replay's own numbers (taken from run_stats, so dashboard/stats/replay can never disagree), type counts match the raw stream and sum to the event total, the planned tool profile (4 calls, 1 planned failure) lands in the per-tool table with read_file's failure named, the render is byte-identical across two runs with a stable sha256 fingerprint, the file is self-contained (doctype, inline <style>, zero http(s) URLs, zero <script> tags, closes </html>), a raw token hand-written into a journal is re-redacted at render time (defense in depth — the secret never reaches the view), the empty journal renders the honest zero state, a torn tail is reported with the dense prefix still counted, the canonical JSON round-trips, and the CLI contract holds (0 = wrote, 1 = missing journal)
